In the diagram, $Q$ lies on the segment $PT$. The given vectors are $\overrightarrow{PO}=w$ and $\overrightarrow{OT}=n$. The lengths satisfy $PQ:QT=1:1$.

Express $\overrightarrow{QO}$ in terms of $w$ and $n$. Fill in both coefficients, including their signs.

$\overrightarrow{QO}=$ {{field-1}} $w+$ {{field-2}} $n$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First express both endpoint vectors in the directions away from $O$:

$$
\overrightarrow{OP}=-w\qquad \overrightarrow{OT}=n .
$$

Trace the path from $P$ through $O$ to $T$:

$$
\overrightarrow{PT}=\overrightarrow{PO}+\overrightarrow{OT}=w+n.
$$

The ratio $PQ:QT=1:1$ gives $2$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{PQ}=\frac{1}{2}\overrightarrow{PT}=\frac{1}{2}(w+n).
$$

Add along the path $O\to P\to Q$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OQ}&=\overrightarrow{OP}+\overrightarrow{PQ}\\&=-w+\frac{1}{2}(w+n)\\&=-\frac{1}{2}w+\frac{1}{2}n.\end{aligned}
$$

The requested vector has the reverse direction, so negate both coefficients:

$$
\overrightarrow{QO}=-\overrightarrow{OQ}=\frac{1}{2}w-\frac{1}{2}n.
$$

In the diagram, $J$ lies on the segment $DA$. The given vectors are $\overrightarrow{DO}=t$ and $\overrightarrow{AO}=v$. The lengths satisfy $DJ:JA=1:5$.

Express $\overrightarrow{JO}$ in terms of $t$ and $v$. Fill in both coefficients, including their signs.

$\overrightarrow{JO}=$ {{field-1}} $t+$ {{field-2}} $v$
question.:question/worked-solution:
First express both endpoint vectors in the directions away from $O$:

$$
\overrightarrow{OD}=-t\qquad \overrightarrow{OA}=-v .
$$

Trace the path from $D$ through $O$ to $A$:

$$
\overrightarrow{DA}=\overrightarrow{DO}+\overrightarrow{OA}=t-v.
$$

The ratio $DJ:JA=1:5$ gives $6$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{DJ}=\frac{1}{6}\overrightarrow{DA}=\frac{1}{6}(t-v).
$$

Add along the path $O\to D\to J$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OJ}&=\overrightarrow{OD}+\overrightarrow{DJ}\\&=-t+\frac{1}{6}(t-v)\\&=-\frac{5}{6}t-\frac{1}{6}v.\end{aligned}
$$

The requested vector has the reverse direction, so negate both coefficients:

$$
\overrightarrow{JO}=-\overrightarrow{OJ}=\frac{5}{6}t+\frac{1}{6}v.
$$

$$

$$

$$

$$

The requested vector has the reverse direction, so negate both coefficients:

$$
\overrightarrow{EO}=-\overrightarrow{OE}=\frac{2}{3}n-\frac{1}{3}d.
$$
